description: The sequential ramp, for a value quantized to colour (a heatmap cell, a region of a map). Ten steps chosen by hand, from indigo through teal to chartreuse, each lighter than the last. A primitive with a value per theme, as a generated ramp is: step 100 is the end nearest the page, the chartreuse end in light and the indigo end in dark, so the common tier names one step in both.
